notes: The Shinobi 7 (base model, not the newer "Shinobi 7 RX" wireless receiver variant) is a 7" 4K HDMI/SDI on-camera field monitor, not a rack/AV-room device, so rackUnits is omitted. Manufacturer's own tech-specs page (atomos.com/tech-specs/shinobi-7/) is JS-rendered and an automated fetch of it returned an incomplete/contradictory port list (omitting USB/RJ45 entirely), so this entry is instead built from and cross-checked against three secondary sources that agree with each other: a reseller spec table (precision-camera.com, used as sourceUrl), Dodd Camera's product page, and CineD's launch-announcement article — plus voltage/DC-jack detail pulled from the manufacturer's own spec page content. HDMI is rated 2.0 (up to 4Kp60); SDI is 3G-SDI (up to 2K60), physically on BNC connectors. USB and RJ45 ports are documented but multiple sources note they are placeholders "for future development" of camera-control features rather than active data ports today. The camera-control jack is a 2.5mm serial/LANC-style connector; no 2.5mm id exists in the given connector list, so trs-3.5 was used as the closest approximation — treat this as an approximation, not an exact match. Power is a locking 5.5x2.1mm DC barrel jack (6.2-16.8V) plus dual hot-swappable NP-F/L-series battery slots (battery slots omitted from the port list since they aren't a listed connector type). Confidence is medium because the truly authoritative manufacturer spec page could not be reliably scraped and some details (USB-A vs USB-C, exact camera-control connector) show minor inconsistency across sources.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Listed by Atomos/retailers as a control port reserved for future camera-control features; not yet functional at launch per manufacturer messaging.

ports.name: RJ45
ports.note: Ethernet-style control port reserved for future camera-control/networking features; no link-speed grade published.

ports.name: Camera Control
ports.note: Physical connector is a 2.5mm serial/LANC-style jack (closest list id used: trs-3.5, not an exact match); used with an optional USB-C-to-serial cable for cameras such as Z CAM.

ports.name: DC In
ports.note: Locking DC jack, 5.5mm OD / 2.1mm ID, 6.2-16.8V input range. Also dual hot-swappable NP-F/L-series battery slots (not a fixed connector type, so not listed as a separate port).
